note: The hex planet: a Goldberg polyhedron, the dual of an icosahedron subdivided frequency times (10·f²+2 cards, twelve of them pentagons), each card a prism standing at its biome's height. Its maps are play's files by their BLAKE3 hash, each in one grid format (width, height, codes, run-length rows).

land.source: Natural Earth 110m land (naturalearthdata.com), a quarter-degree mask

biomes.source: Köppen-Geiger 0.5° (Kottek et al. 2006, World Map of the Köppen-Geiger climate classification updated, Meteorologische Zeitschrift 15:259–263), folded into the planet's kinds
biomes.licence: freely downloadable from koeppen-geiger.vu-wien.ac.at; cite Kottek et al. 2006

depth.source: Natural Earth 10m bathymetry (naturalearthdata.com), its depth layers on a quarter-degree grid

mountains.source: Natural Earth 50m geography regions, the Range/mtn polygons (naturalearthdata.com), rasterised at a quarter degree
